translations.web: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”
translations.bsb: The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God stands forever.”
translations.kjv: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
